exposure: Pregnancy in women with Turner syndrome
Aortic event risk stratification (low vs moderate-to-high)
Conception method (Assisted Reproductive Technology vs spontaneous)
cohort: The study included 47 pregnancies in women previously diagnosed with Turner syndrome.
finding: Pregnancy outcomes in women with Turner syndrome were better than previously reported, though significant aortic growth occurred during pregnancy but appeared reversible postpartum.
mod_finding: Women who conceived after assisted reproductive technology (ART) had a higher rate of Cesarean section (65% vs 42%) compared to those with spontaneous conception.
